nina (AE): FYI customer signed MSA. They want a short POC + committed reservation for ~100k qps-month (peaks ~5k RPS). Need a recommended reserved GPU config, burst rules, preheat/runbook, and a ballpark price for fp16 vs 4-bit quant. Also security Q: customer-managed KMS and 13mo logs.
alex (sales_eng): Heard. They care about p99 token latency ~200ms. Can we give a compact config to put in the quote?
mei (solutions): Recommend 6 reserved GPUs (A100-equivalent) with burst credits to +50% (up to 9). AZ spread 3+3. KV-cache warmup typically cuts token ops ~25-35% for sessioned chat.
drew (infra): Ops sketch: autoscale rules: scale_up if gpu_util > 70% for 30s -> +1 GPU; scale_down if gpu_util < 30% for 5m -> -1 GPU. Preheat (short): T-120m start kv-warmup, T-90m synthetic @50% for 30m, T-60m synthetic @75% for 45m validate p99, T-0 allow burst credits for 4h. Smoke cmds: ./kv-warmup --sessions 1000; ./loadgen --rps 3750 --ctx 2000 --dur 45m.
legal-bot: We can offer a conditional SLO: "P99 200ms while preheat runbook is executed as specified; otherwise best-effort." Legal to draft final wording and add ops appendix.
nina (AE): Need final numbers for AE deck + quote by EOD. Mei/Alex/Drew please post per-GPU cost range, autoscale snippet, and preheat checklist in this thread. Thanks! :pray:
